phase-summary.outcome: The shared KAPLAY shell refit is complete: navigation, combat, action menu, rune forge, inventory, and dialogue all run through the common three-column scene layout and command/room-brief organisms. This closes layout-parity work, but not human playability.

changes.change: Current gameplay scenes rely on shared shell/layout primitives instead of ad hoc scene-local panel composition.
Left-panel command routing, center content surfaces, and right-panel room/journal surfaces are consistently present across the active KAPLAY screens.
Phase 45 is now formally closed; the remaining issues are interaction clarity, onboarding, and menu hierarchy and are moved into Phase 46.

next.action: Phase 46 now owns the human-player recovery work: simplify inputs, rebuild the `/play` shell around explicit menu hierarchy, and improve cutscene/dialogue/combat readability.

requriements-suggestions.item: Gameplay requirements should distinguish layout parity from human playability so shell reuse is not mistaken for an actually legible player experience.
